rules.content: All players must maintain character integrity at all times. FailRP (behaving in a way that breaks immersion or makes no logical sense in real life) is strictly prohibited. You must value your life and act realistically.
When held at gunpoint or outnumbered by armed players, your character must show realistic fear for their life. You cannot pull a weapon while a gun is aimed directly at your head.
Randomly attacking or killing other players without prior roleplay initiation is strictly banned. Using vehicles as weapons (VDM) is prohibited unless justified by high-tier roleplay context.
If you bleed out and respawn at the hospital, your character forgets all events leading up to their death. You cannot return to the scene of your death for 15 minutes.
Criminal activities involving hostages require a minimum of 4 active LSPD officers online. Max group limit for bank heists is 4 players.
